title: Three Springs and One Short Trowel
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：produce　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 produce 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the gardener ① sold the produce that no apprentice in the garden would have described, and he said the selling was the whole of the spring. The ② produce, meaning the crop itself and not the trowel, ran three springs and stayed undescribed in the book; produce, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of produce in that garden had the same short trowel beside it, and the ④ produce at the far bed, meaning the cutting they kept for the children to plant and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Produce, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the gardener said the describing is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the produce was the whole of the matter, meaning the yield and not the crop. The ⑥ produce, meaning the yield and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; produce, he said, is either something you sell or the only word that means both crop and a yield. He said the yield is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ produce had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short trowel. The ⑧ produce of the whole thing, the gardener wrote in April, was one garden and three springs of describing; produce, he said, is either the cutting at the far bed or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ produce I remember is the produce described in the notebook, which closed in 1971 and is still described as the quietest in the garden. ⑩ Produce, my mother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being described; all produce, she said, is a yield that has agreed to look like crop. She said the yield was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 农产品（指园子里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 农产品（指那批农产品本身，与小小的花铲相对）
C. 固定搭配：sell the produce 卖这一批农产品
D. n. 农产品（指留给孩子们插的那一枝）
E. n. 农产品之事（抽象总称，指一处园子的农产品之事）
F. n. 农产品（指园艺笔记里写到、被描述的那一批）
G. n. 农产品、收成（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 收成（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sold the produce that no apprentice in the garden would have described

answers.why: sell the produce 意为“卖这一批农产品”，1964 年那位园丁把园子里没有一位学徒肯描述的一批农产品做了一遍。
produce 意为“农产品”，指那批农产品本身而不是小小的花铲，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被描述。
produce 意为“农产品”，指园子里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一把小小的花铲。
produce 意为“农产品”，指最远那畦苗床的留给孩子们插的那一枝，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
produce 意为“农产品、收成”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这批收成就是那件事的全部。
produce 意为“收成”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那批农产品，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
produce 意为“农产品”，指园艺笔记里写到、被描述的那一批，到 1969 年这一批成了园艺笔记里的一行。
produce 意为“农产品之事”，园丁四月写道，整件事的农产品之事是一处园子和三个春天的描述。
produce 意为“农产品”，我记得的是园艺笔记里描述过的那一批，1971 年栽完了，至今仍被说成园子里最安静的一批。
produce 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，农产品是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的农产品。
